name: First Division at New Berne
location: New Berne First Division report scope
notes: DRAFT; not loaded. [I] Snapshot identity and force-block mapping proposed. Stores unknown; not zero. Less-than 4,000 claim is a limit, not 4,000 actual. No enemy estimate used as own return. S21: Branch says he had at no time been able to place 4,000 men in the field at New Berne and was seriously weakened by re-enlistment furloughs at the battle. 4,000 is therefore an exclusive upper bound, not an exact March 14 strength; no numerical lower bound or present-for-duty category is supplied.
sources: OR I-IX pp.240-242; OR I-IX pp.241-242
